# Definition of done

- DOD-001: Work is done when it builds with zero warnings, every test passes, every CI gate passes, and docs and ADRs are updated in the same PR.
- DOD-002: Report done only with evidence (commands run, counts, links), and state "not verified" wherever something wasn't.
- DOD-003: Before the owner reviews, an independent read-only reviewer that hasn't seen the work runs the gates and reports ranked findings; reviews repeat after each round of fixes and end at the first round with nothing blocking or should-fix.
- DOD-004: Every PR uses the PR template, including the red-to-green evidence table; a PR whose description a bot writes carries the evidence as DOD-006 says, and a release PR is the owner's.
- DOD-005: Every review finding on a PR is checked against the code and answered with evidence; a fixed or already-fixed one is resolved as addressed, a wrong one as incorrect, and one left unfixed as won't fix: in review mode only with the owner's OK, in auto mode with the agent's reason in the reply.
- DOD-006: A PR whose description a bot writes, such as Dependabot's, keeps that description. In either mode, before the PR is merged, the agent handling it posts the template's sections as a PR comment: 'What and why'; 'Red → green evidence' for any behavior change an agent added, one row per test-list item (a bot's own commits need none); 'Checks run', with the reviewer agent's findings and how each was answered; 'For the owner'; and 'Not verified'. The comment names the head commit its counts come from, which must be the commit the PR is merged at: when the head moves, as it does when a lock-file refresh pushes or Dependabot rebases, the agent posts a new one. That comment stands in for the complete description a merge needs, whoever merges the PR. Release PRs are the owner's, so this doesn't cover them.
